# Tell Jane

> > Tell Jane is the UK's leading HR consultancy specializing in harassment prevention, discrimination awareness, and inclusive workplace culture through training, consultancy, and independent investigations.

Tell Jane provides comprehensive HR solutions including bespoke training programmes, ED&I consultancy, workplace investigations, and mediation services. The organization focuses on building empathetic, inclusive workplaces across the UK by equipping employees and HR teams with tools to prevent harassment, bullying, and discrimination.

## Key Topics

- Harassment Prevention
- Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (ED&I)
- Workplace Investigations
- HR Consultancy
- Employee Training
- Workplace Culture
- Mediation Services
- LGBTQ+ Awareness
- Disability Discrimination
- Sexual Harassment Prevention
- Anti-Bullying Training
- Inclusive Behaviours
- Employee Resource Groups
- Dignity and Respect at Work
- Anonymous Reporting

## Workplace Investigations & Dispute Resolution

- [Independent Workplace Investigations](https://www.telljane.co.uk/hr-consultancy-and-support/workplace-investigations): Tell Jane's independent workplace investigations handling grievances fairly across UK.
- [Workplace Mediation Services](https://www.telljane.co.uk/hr-consultancy-and-support/mediation): Tell Jane's outcome-focused workplace mediation resolving employee disputes early.
- [Anonymous Reporting Freephone Hotline](https://www.telljane.co.uk/hr-consultancy-and-support/anonymous-reporting-hotline): Tell Jane's anonymous reporting hotline ensuring employee concerns are heard safely.
- [Workplace Investigations Training Course](https://www.telljane.co.uk/hr-consultancy-and-support/workplace-investigation-training): Tell Jane's three-module investigation training upskilling HR and leadership teams.
